about.label: About this widget
about.kept: Nothing was read on the latest attempt: nothing below is current.
about.answered: What the daemon answered on this read.
about.catalog_omitted: catalog not requested for this quota read
about.facet_note: Each facet the daemon did not answer is shown from its last answer, dated, or as not read — never as zero.
about.lg_held: held back now (cooldown, model limit reported reached, another limit spent)
about.b_windows: Each account counts 1 whatever its plan: its share left of a limit is added up, so accounts with 40% and 70% left make 1.10 account-windows. Not tokens or hours.
about.b_bars: One per account the limit applies to, fullest first — each window sorted on its own, so a column does not follow one account from window to window. Every window has one scale: full height is 100% left, the base 0%. A hatched bar is a last-known value — dated, not current; a “?” has no usable value and is not counted. Click a bar to select its account: its bars are marked in every window.
about.b_figure: Account-windows left now, of the accounts the limit applies to: current readings only. Last-known values are never in it — they stay hatched bars and stand, dated, in the “{note}” note. With no current reading the figure is “—”, never 0. The limit whose measured accounts have the lowest average share left is named in the figure’s hint, nowhere else: a ranking, not a verdict on what can run. A limit scoped to models binds only the models it names, never the family’s other models{scoped}.
about.b_timeline: Behind now, each account starts at its first recorded value. Dashed portions carry older readings through missing answers; hover for age and provenance. Membership changes break the line, and passing a reported reset never fabricates a past refill. Ahead, one condition on the accounts read now: no new use (each keeps its share and refills once at its next reported reset), or recent pace (the accounts with a measured pace keep it, the others are held). Neither is a forecast, and no reset nobody reported is assumed. A window’s tab puts its limit in the plate and the timeline; the plate’s word “Chart” (pressed while the chart is shown) folds the timeline.
about.b_never: Limits of different length or model are never added together: a 5-hour and a weekly limit bound the same work at once. Measured quota is not a dispatch guarantee: Claudexor decides routing.
eng.no_quota_window: No quota window reported for this account
